payload.summary:
An Iranian dhow was hijacked by pirates and potentially used
as a mothership. EUNAVFOR OP ATALANTA closely
monitored the situation and, in coordination with Somali
authorities, disrupted the Pirate Action Group (PAG) and
freed the hijacked dhow on 06 April 2026. All crew members
are reported safe.
